description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the Statute for Voluntary Child Development Centers, No. 04 of 2018
reasoning: The gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a draft provincial statute ("Statute for Voluntary Child Development Centers of Central Provincial Council No. 04 of 2018") that establishes legal provisions for the registration, supervision, and administration of child development centers. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves creating new regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments, specifically a provincial statute that will become law after approval processes. While a minister's name appears in the notification section, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing legal/regulatory content rather than being a personnel announcement with detailed portfolio responsibilities.
